title: 강당 뒷자리
suno_analysis_sp: J-Rock and Pop-Punk fusion. Distorted electric guitars play palm-muted power chords in the verses and open, ringing chords in the chorus. A driving drum kit features a consistent eighth-note hi-hat pattern and a heavy snare backbeat. The bass guitar follows the kick drum pattern with a bright, overdriven tone. Male vocals are delivered with a melodic, energetic belt, shifting to a higher register in the chorus. The arrangement features a sudden dynamic swell leading into the chorus. Key of E Major. Tempo is 175 BPM.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[distorted electric guitar power chords, rapid drum fill]
[Chorus]
[full band, high-energy drums]
(Woah-oh-oh-oh!)

[Verse 1]
[palm-muted electric guitar, bass and drums continue]
점심 시간에 강당에서 소리가 나요
밴드부 연습 소리에요
축제가 다음 주거든요
뒷문이 열려 있었어요
들어갔어요 맨 뒷줄에 앉았죠
어두니까 안 보일 거예요
아마요 아마
[guitar feedback swell]

[Chorus]
[open power chords, crash cymbals]
무대 뒤에 너가 언제 앉아 있었어
그래요 교실에서는 말도 잘 안 하는 애요
필통에 스틱을 넣고 다니는 것만 알았어요
근데 드럼 앞에 앉으니까
